subject.title: Doubao/BytePlus model catalog: cacheRead/cacheWrite pricing set to 0, missing context caching cost

question: Should maintainers retarget or replace the open fork PR, and what vendor-backed cacheRead/cacheWrite mapping should OpenClaw use for BytePlus and Volcengine/Doubao model catalogs?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but hard-coding pricing requires current vendor-proof and a maintainer choice about cache storage/write mapping before automation should open another competing fix.

options.title: Confirm pricing and replace the stale PR
options.body: Use the current plugin manifest surface for both BytePlus and Volcengine/Doubao, then close or supersede the conflicting fork PR once a clean same-repo fix lands.

options.title: Adopt and retarget the fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to move the existing fix from deleted core catalog files into the current plugin manifests and tests.

options.title: Pause until vendor billing proof is available
options.body: Keep the issue open without a fix PR until maintainers can verify the exact cache-read, cache-write, and storage-pricing contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm pricing and replace the stale PR
recommendation.body: Use the current plugin manifest surface for both BytePlus and Volcengine/Doubao, then close or supersede the conflicting fork PR once a clean same-repo fix lands.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person to the manifest-owned provider catalog refactor and current plugin surface where the fix now belongs.
